name: Özlem Fedai Korçak
bio: Özlem Fedai Korçak was born and raised in Bursa during the ’80s. She’s an engineer with a PhD, and a full-time dreamcrafter. As a little girl, she painted her dreams, and when her daughter was born, she started drawing for her. Later she wrote children’s books and illustrated magazines. She took courses in London on illustrating children’s books. Her greatest joy is chatting with monsters she’s drawn, and lazing around with Yoda, her cat.
